data.desc: The Company's operating history began in 1993 when Fenbo Industries Limited was founded in Hong Kong by Mr. Li Kin Shing as a toy manufacturer and distributor. As the toy market deteriorated, he founded Able Industries Limited in 2005 in Hong Kong and shifted the operations to the manufacturing and sales of personal care electric appliances. The manufacturing subsidiary, Fenbo Plastic Products Factory (Shenzhen) Ltd., located in Guangdong, PRC, was formed in the PRC in 2010 and is capable of producing over three million units per year. The Company currently act as both an original equipment manufacturer and historically have also served as an original design manufacturer.
